name: The NewPort Sauna
description:
Dont be mistaken, the Newport Sauna is very spacious inside and offers great comfort. It includes all the features that you would expect in a sauna. The corner design make this a unique sauna for home, it is a beautiful piece of furniture and would be beneficial for the whole family ! 

The Newport has an elegant design that will offer you many hours of pleasurable moment alone with your loved one. Take advantage of the sauna benefits and enjoy the soft heat provided by the carbon wave 360 heaters. Use the Chromotherapy lighting to create a romantic ambiance and heal yourself of the stress while relaxing inside your personal Oasis.

Improve you health today !
